messages:
alex: Putting up a PR to split the usage tiers page into a Metering page and a Pricing page. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842. Need review on SDK snippets and dashboard links.
maya: Link please?
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
jordan: Quick scan: Python example calls `client.create_metering` which is deprecated. Update to `client.report_usage`. Also remove hardcoded grafana panel IDs.
samir: I can patch the code block. Do we want to keep an old-style snippet for older SDKs?
ciara: Keep legacy example but mark as deprecated with a short note and migration steps.
li: Add a migration checklist: update headers (`X-Usage-Tier`), change payload field `token_count` -> `token_total`, and mention burst-window semantics. Include JSON schema sample.
alex: Will add checklist to PR description and the migration guide.
maya: The phrase about throttling is vague. State that clients receive 429 with Retry-After and a quota reason field.
jordan: I'll add an example 429 response and a compact exponential backoff snippet:
```
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.request(...)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', '1')) * (2 ** attempt)
        time.sleep(wait)
    else:
        break
```
samir: Ops requested we avoid raw panel IDs in public docs. Use `{{panel_link}}` tokens that map internally to the right dashboard. I contacted infra for a stable redirect.
alex: Swapping IDs for tokens. Adding docs-test for the snippet using the docs mock endpoint.
ciara: Staging preview looks good. Deprecated banner renders and the examples pass the doctest.
docs-bot: staging deploy successful - https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/tiers
alex: CI green, linter fixed an extra trailing space. Merged.
maya: Add a line to release notes: "Split usage tiers into Metering and Pricing; updated SDK examples; tokenized dashboard links; migration checklist added."
ciara: Merged. :tada:
alex: Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
